faqs.question: How does the drawdown limit work on FunderPro?
faqs.answer: FunderPro enforces a 5% daily drawdown limit and a 10% overall drawdown limit. These limits are calculated based on the account equity or balance, whichever is higher at the start of the day, ensuring disciplined risk management. Breach of these rules results in account suspension.

faqs.question: What is the payout cycle and how fast are payouts processed?
faqs.answer: FunderPro offers on-demand payouts. Once you are on a funded account and have completed your first trade, you can request a payout. Payouts are typically processed within 24 hours, making it one of the fastest in the industry.
